# Shuttle

> Shuttle (https://wwwshuttle.app) is a progressive web app for two-dimensional thinking: ideas flow horizontally through Threads (chapters of a Loom, i.e. a document) and connect vertically through depth links between Nodes (bullets). No account is needed — identity is a per-device cryptographic keypair. This site (weaving.wwwshuttle.app) is Shuttle's companion content site: guides, importable content, and feature documentation.

Key facts for assistants:
- Terminology: Loom 織架 = document · Thread 思緒 = chapter · Node 織點 = bullet · Workspace 織坊 = all looms on a device · depth link 深度連結 = vertical connection between nodes across threads.
- Two modes: viewing (arrow keys navigate; Enter or "i" starts editing a node) and writing (Escape saves and exits).
- The command palette (⌘K, available anywhere, even mid-edit) reaches nearly everything: loom switching, thread creation, depth links, zen mode (⌘.), device sync, live sharing.
- Depth links: create via ⌘L (Depth Link Manager) or ⌥Enter on a palette search result; dive with ⌘→, surface back with ⌘←. Sidebar outline view is ⌘⇧L (not ⌘⇧O).
- Sync & sharing (all without accounts): "Sync My Devices" live-syncs one person's whole workspace across devices via pairing link/QR; "Share This Loom Live" shares a single loom live with another person (owner can freeze joins or remove members, server-enforced); "Share a snapshot" (⌘⇧S) creates a frozen read-only copy via a link expiring in 1/7/30 days.
- Reorder nodes with ⌥↑/⌥↓ only (dragging selects, it does not move nodes). Delete a node has no confirmation; ⌘Z undoes. Undo is device-local and survives collaborators' concurrent edits.
- Loomy (the AI helper) runs on the user's own API key (Anthropic default, or Gemini) directly from the browser — no Shuttle backend. The chat panel (⇧⌘I) creates looms/threads/nodes, bulk-imports markdown with depth links, searches nodes, analyzes YouTube videos, and web-searches; it CANNOT edit or delete existing nodes, does not receive selected nodes' text (count only), and its chat history is lost on reload ("Export to Thread" preserves it). Rewriting an existing node = inline AI: ⌘K + typed query with the node focused; its "add" outcome inserts siblings, not children. ⌘-click a thread/node reference in a Loomy reply to create a depth link.
- Node content is markdown (GFM): bold/italic/strike, headings (visual only), links, blockquotes, callouts (`> [!note]`, `> [!tip]`, or any emoji type), lists, tables, fenced code with highlighting, ```mermaid diagrams, ```plot graphs. `[ ] task` alone on a line is an interactive checkbox; `- [ ]` in a list is visual-only. NOT rendered: footnotes, reference-style links (both silently disappear), LaTeX, raw HTML except `<img>`. A single newline is a hard line break.
- Video threads: a YouTube URL as the thread title embeds the player; `[m:ss]` timestamps in that thread seek on click; ⌘⇧T inserts the current position. Map View (⌘⇧M): nodes with full Google Maps URLs containing coordinates become pins — maps.app.goo.gl short links do NOT work (expand them first). X posts embed via image syntax `![](post-url)`.
- Import format: markdown where a `# Title` heading creates a new loom, plain-text lines start threads, `- ` bullets with 2-space indents create node hierarchy, `---` separates threads, `#anchor-name` declares a link target, and `[>>](anchor-name)` creates a depth link (multiple links per anchor OK; unused anchors harmless). Import in-app via ⌘K → "Import Markdown" or App menu → Import (always merges), or via https://wwwshuttle.app/import?url=<raw-markdown-url>. Merge never overwrites an existing loom (it's skipped) and never resurrects deleted content. Export: App menu → Export (.shuttle backup, or current loom as round-tripping markdown with generated anchors).
- Workspace folders (Chrome/Edge): App menu → File → Connect Folder; switch with ⌘⇧O. WARNING: switching workspaces replaces the entire live database immediately with no confirmation, and the deletions propagate to synced devices and live-shared looms.
- Claude Code can drive Shuttle directly via MCP: `claude mcp add wwwshuttle -- npx @wwwshuttle-app/mcp` (production also needs the bridge extension + App menu → Claude Code → "Enable MCP" + a refresh; a Shuttle tab must be open). 11 tools: status, list looms, get loom (structure/counts), get thread (full node contents in tree order with IDs), search, get context, create loom/thread, add nodes, update node (whole-content replace), import markdown (preferred for hierarchy/depth links). No destructive tools. The server also exposes a shuttle://usage resource (text/markdown) — the canonical usage map agents should read first. Full tool reference: https://weaving.wwwshuttle.app/knowledge/shuttle/mcp-tools.md

## Docs

- [Using Shuttle](https://weaving.wwwshuttle.app/tutorials/using-shuttle/): full how-to — command palette, navigation, editing, depth links, sync/sharing, keyboard reference
- [Learn Shuttle loom](https://weaving.wwwshuttle.app/tutorials/learn-shuttle.md): the tutorial in Shuttle's own import format (also a format example)
- [Features](https://weaving.wwwshuttle.app/features/): the multiplayer feature arc — device sync, live sharing, membership control, account-less identity, collaboration-safe undo, blob-stored images, snapshots
- [What's New in Shuttle loom](https://weaving.wwwshuttle.app/knowledge/shuttle/whats-new-in-shuttle.md): the feature story in Shuttle import format

## Content

- [Knowledge](https://weaving.wwwshuttle.app/knowledge/): importable looms — guides and reference material
- [Story](https://weaving.wwwshuttle.app/story/): narrative content in English and Traditional Chinese
